meta.caption: Lambda 0 GCN-LSTM and IDW on the synthetic dataset 05902f5167e6a8aefa02386b6437bfa984a2ec3b67e3fffee7c69d7b145c8351. Physics was not run. Default method is the lower common-mask validation MAE. This is not field accuracy.

evaluation.notes: Completed methods share well-dates with a finite IDW prediction, a finite lambda-0 GCN-LSTM prediction, and a valid label. Validation uses train_masked wells. Test uses holdout wells. Each date is one pair. gcn_lstm_physics was not run and is outside this mask. Unrestricted IDW validation MAE on train_masked labels is 1.0872565960824558 m over 959 pairs; the IDW metric in this file is the common mask, not that unrestricted score. Chart rows are the exported test dates and are not the pair count. Positive-lambda selection is later.
